title: Operations & Project Coordinator
summary: Coordinate founder priorities, scheduling, follow-ups, and project delivery across JD Productions.
description:
JD Productions is building its technology, production, and commercial operations. The Operations & Project Coordinator will help the founder keep priorities, schedules, and commitments organized as work moves across products and services.

The role combines practical founder support with project coordination: prepare meetings, maintain a clear record of decisions, track owners and deadlines, and follow up when a deliverable or approval is missing. Research & Testing engagements are an initial area of focus. The aim is to reduce day-to-day administrative work for the founder and make progress visible across the company.

You will coordinate with the people assigned to each project, including contractors where engaged. Financial commitments, hiring decisions, contracts, and client scope changes remain with the person authorized to approve them. This description defines the work the company needs; it does not imply that a fully staffed operations team is already in place.
responsibilities:
Maintain the founder’s agreed priorities, calendar, scheduling requests, and follow-up list.
Prepare meeting agendas, briefing materials, notes, and action items; route decisions for approval.
Maintain project plans with owners, deadlines, dependencies, and accurate status.
Coordinate Research & Testing intake handoffs, scope review meetings, deliverables, and client follow-ups.
Follow up with project owners and contractors and surface blockers before commitments are missed.
Organize contracts, project documents, and approved procedures with appropriate access controls.
Improve recurring administrative tasks and prepare concise operational reports for the founder.
qualifications:
Experience coordinating projects, schedules, or operations with multiple stakeholders.
Clear written communication and reliable follow-through on action items.
Ability to prioritize competing requests and identify when an approval is required.
Comfort with spreadsheets, calendars, documents, and project-management tools.
Discretion with confidential company, candidate, and client information.
timingNote: Applications are accepted. Compensation, location, work arrangement, schedule, and start date have not been confirmed.

title: Business Development & Partnerships Intern
summary: Support prospect research, outreach preparation, and the Research & Testing pipeline under supervision.
description:
Help JD Productions build a disciplined record of prospective customers and partners. The initial focus is Research & Testing: digital experience reviews, software QA, and market and product research.

You will research organizations, identify relevant needs and contacts, prepare outreach drafts, and keep the customer-relationship record current. You will also help assemble proposals and track the next step in a business conversation. Work will be reviewed by the founder or an assigned business-development supervisor.

This is a supervised internship. You will not independently negotiate prices, sign agreements, promise delivery dates, or represent an unapproved service capability. Research and careful preparation come before outreach.
responsibilities:
Research prospective clients and partners and record the source, relevance, and next step.
Identify where JD’s defined Research & Testing offers may address a prospect’s stated needs.
Prepare outreach drafts and briefing notes for review before they are sent.
Maintain CRM records, contact history, qualification notes, and follow-up dates.
Assist with proposals using approved scopes, prices, and service descriptions.
Track responses and hand qualified opportunities to the founder or authorized lead.
Prepare concise pipeline summaries that distinguish interest from an agreement.
qualifications:
Interest in business development, entrepreneurship, marketing, or commercial research.
Ability to research an organization and summarize findings clearly.
Comfort maintaining spreadsheets or customer-relationship records.
Careful handling of contact information and willingness to follow approved outreach processes.
Willingness to receive feedback and revise work before external use.
learningOutcomes:
Practice prospect research and evidence-based qualification.
Learn how a service pipeline is documented and reviewed.
Prepare outreach and proposal materials within defined commercial boundaries.

title: Operations & Venture Development Intern
summary: Support meeting preparation, founder follow-ups, task tracking, and venture research under supervision.
description:
Support the day-to-day coordination that helps a founder-led company keep work moving. You will help prepare meetings, organize documents, maintain task trackers, and collect the information needed for founder follow-ups.

The role also supports venture research: summarize requirements, identify unanswered questions, and prepare material for review. Research & Testing operations provide an initial setting for learning how inquiries, scopes, project tasks, and deliverables are coordinated.

You will work under the founder or an assigned operations supervisor. The internship does not carry independent executive authority: you do not approve spending, make hiring decisions, sign agreements, or commit the company to a project. Executive coordination belongs within this role rather than a separate, overlapping internship.

Prepare draft agendas, meeting materials, notes, and action lists for review.
Help organize scheduling requests and track approved founder follow-ups.
Maintain task and project trackers with owners, dates, status, and dependencies.
Organize internal documentation and record decisions accurately.
Support Research & Testing inquiry and delivery coordination without independently accepting engagements.
Research venture requirements and summarize evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions.
Help document repeatable procedures and flag missed or unclear handoffs.
qualifications:

Strong organization and clear written communication.
Comfort with calendars, spreadsheets, documents, and task-management tools.
Ability to distinguish a request from an approved decision.
Discretion with confidential records and willingness to work within a reviewed scope.
learningOutcomes:

Learn project tracking, document control, and operational handoffs.
Research venture requirements without treating an idea as an approved commitment.

title: Research & Testing Lead
summary: Establish research and QA methods, review client scopes and evidence, and supervise delivery.
description:
JD Productions is accepting applications for an upcoming Research & Testing Lead opportunity. This experienced role will establish practical methods for digital experience reviews, software quality assurance, and market and product research.

The lead will translate client questions into a written scope, define an evaluation plan, review findings, and prepare reports that distinguish evidence from interpretation. Supervising junior contributors and setting clear limits on their access and responsibilities are central to the role.

Client work requires written authorization identifying the systems, actions, data, and limits in scope. The lead must stop work that falls outside that authorization and route security, legal, or specialist questions to qualified oversight. This is not a claim that JD operates an accredited laboratory, provides penetration testing, or certifies regulatory compliance. Hiring timing and engagement terms remain to be confirmed.
responsibilities:
Develop repeatable methods for JD’s defined experience testing, QA, and research services.
Confirm evaluation goals, deliverables, environments, access limits, and written client authorization before work begins.
Prepare test and research plans with clear coverage, evidence requirements, and completion criteria.
Supervise interns and other assigned contributors through bounded tasks and documented review.
Review reproducible defects, usability observations, and research sources for accuracy and relevance.
Produce prioritized findings and recommendations with limitations and unresolved questions.
Coordinate delivery reviews, approved retests, and client handoffs.
Escalate work requiring expertise or authority outside the agreed service scope.
qualifications:
Demonstrated experience planning and delivering software QA, digital experience evaluations, or product research.
Evidence of writing clear test plans, findings, or client reports.
Experience reviewing others’ work and mentoring junior contributors.
Ability to distinguish confirmed defects, observations, assumptions, and unsupported conclusions.
Sound judgment about client authorization, least-privilege access, confidential information, and scope limits.
Ability to coordinate relevant specialist review when a question exceeds your expertise.
timingNote: Upcoming opportunity. Applications are accepted for future consideration; the hiring timetable and engagement terms have not been confirmed.

title: Software QA & Product Testing Intern
summary: Execute supervised test cases and document reproducible defects in websites, applications, and workflows.
description:
Support JD Productions’ Research & Testing work by checking websites, applications, and software workflows against an approved test plan. You will document steps, expected results, observed results, and evidence another person can reproduce.

An assigned qualified supervisor will define the scope and review your findings. Testing takes place only in approved environments with written authorization; you will not receive unrestricted production credentials or independently approve a release. Security probing, load testing, changes to live customer data, and activities outside the authorized plan are not part of an intern’s independent remit.
responsibilities:
Execute assigned functional and regression test cases in approved environments.
Record device, browser, version, steps, expected results, and actual results.
Capture permitted screenshots or logs while excluding confidential data.
Report reproducible defects with clear evidence and appropriate severity recommendations.
Retest approved fixes and record whether the original issue remains.
Maintain test records and ask for review when a result or scope limit is unclear.
qualifications:
Interest in software quality, product testing, or web and application development.
Ability to follow a test plan and write clear reproduction steps.
Attention to detail and willingness to distinguish an observation from a confirmed defect.
Basic familiarity with browsers, applications, and digital productivity tools.
Willingness to follow access restrictions, data-handling rules, and supervisor review.
learningOutcomes:
Practice test execution, defect documentation, and approved retesting.
Learn to report coverage and limitations honestly.
Develop safe testing habits within a defined scope.

title: UX Research & Usability Intern
summary: Support usability evaluations and research documentation under qualified supervision.
description:
Help evaluate how people navigate digital products and where they encounter friction. You will support structured interface reviews, prepare research materials, and organize observations for JD Productions’ Research & Testing work.

An assigned qualified supervisor will approve the research question, method, participant arrangements, and report. Studies involving people require an approved plan and appropriate consent before contact or recording. You will not independently recruit participants, collect sensitive information, or present a small sample as a conclusion about every user.
responsibilities:
Review assigned user journeys against agreed evaluation criteria.
Prepare draft study guides, tasks, and note-taking templates for supervisor approval.
Assist with approved study coordination and consent records.
Organize observations and supporting evidence without identifying participants unnecessarily.
Distinguish observed behavior from interpretation and recommendations.
Prepare research summaries with method, sample, limitations, and follow-up questions.
qualifications:
Interest in user experience, design, human behavior, or product research.
Clear writing and careful observation.
Ability to organize notes and explain the evidence behind a finding.
Respect for participant consent, privacy, and confidential product information.
Willingness to use a reviewed method and accept feedback.
learningOutcomes:
Practice structured usability observation and research documentation.
Learn consent, privacy, and limitations in user research.
Translate evidence into carefully qualified design recommendations.

title: Market & Competitive Research Intern
summary: Research markets, competitors, products, and published pricing for client and internal projects.
description:
Support JD Productions’ client research and internal venture planning with careful, source-based investigation. You will study markets, compare products and competitors, and organize published pricing and customer-need evidence around a defined research question.

An assigned supervisor will review the research plan and conclusions. Use public information and client-authorized sources; do not misrepresent your identity, bypass access controls, or obtain confidential competitor material. Reports must distinguish sourced facts, dated observations, assumptions, and recommendations.
responsibilities:
Research assigned industries, competitors, products, and customer needs.
Maintain source links, publication dates, and access dates for material used.
Compare public product features and pricing on a consistent basis.
Record gaps, conflicting sources, and uncertainty rather than filling them with guesses.
Prepare concise research briefs and comparison tables for review.
Support client engagements and internal venture questions within the approved research scope.
qualifications:
Interest in business research, economics, strategy, or product development.
Ability to locate and evaluate relevant sources.
Clear writing and comfort with structured comparisons and spreadsheets.
Attention to dates, definitions, and the difference between an estimate and a verified fact.
Willingness to follow ethical research and confidentiality boundaries.
learningOutcomes:
Practice source evaluation, market mapping, and competitive comparisons.
Learn to document assumptions and research limitations.
Prepare briefs that support a decision without overstating the evidence.

title: Finance & Administrative Operations Intern
summary: Support expense records, draft invoices, document organization, and routine reports under oversight.
description:
Help keep JD Productions’ financial and administrative records organized and ready for review. You will assist with expense documentation, draft invoice preparation, filing, and routine reporting using approved processes.

The founder, an assigned finance supervisor, or a qualified professional retains approval and oversight. The internship does not authorize moving funds, approving payments, signing financial statements, providing accounting or legal advice, or independently accessing banking credentials. Figures must trace to source records, and questions must be escalated rather than resolved by guesswork.
responsibilities:
Organize expense documents and link records to their supporting invoices or receipts.
Prepare draft invoices using approved scope and pricing for authorized review.
Maintain administrative files, checklists, and document versions.
Assist with routine spreadsheet updates and reports from approved source records.
Flag missing documents, inconsistent figures, and questions for the supervisor.
Protect confidential records and follow access and retention instructions.
qualifications:
Interest in finance, accounting, business administration, or operations.
Basic spreadsheet skills and attention to numerical accuracy.
Ability to organize documents and follow a reviewed process.
Discretion with financial, personal, and client information.
Understanding that preparation, approval, and payment are separate responsibilities.
learningOutcomes:
Practice record organization and source-based reporting.
Learn invoice preparation and basic administrative controls.
Develop confidentiality and escalation habits under professional oversight.
